risks.risk: Functional failure may exist despite the seller’s claim (disc drive, system stability, overheating).
risks.proof: Video: power on to home screen + run a game for 10–15 minutes; show no shutdown/overheat warning.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: not fully working/unknown condition.

risks.risk: Ports may be faulty (HDMI/USB/Ethernet), which affects usability and resale.
risks.proof: Video or photos: close-ups of each port + test showing HDMI output and at least two USB devices working.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: some ports may not work.

risks.risk: Controller may have drift/button issues or may not match the claimed “double pad” set.
risks.proof: Video: controller connected; show analog movement and a simple calibration/no-drift check.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: controller may need repair/replacement.

risks.risk: “Never opened” cannot be verified without underside/void-sticker evidence.
risks.proof: Clear photo of underside/model label and screw heads (showing whether opened) and any void stickers.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: repair/open history unknown.

risks.risk: Receipt/ownership proof not shown; could be missing or not match the console serial.
risks.proof: Photo of the UK receipt (blur personal details) + matching serial/model label photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: no valid receipt proof.

proof_requests: Power-on video to home screen + 10–15 minutes gameplay/stress test (no overheating/shutdown).
Port test video: HDMI output + USB (at least two ports) + Ethernet (if available).
Underside photo showing model/serial label and screw heads/void stickers.
Controller test video (buttons + analog movement/no drift).
Photo of the UK receipt and a matching serial/model label photo.
response.reason: The seller’s text claim is not proof, and no new photos/videos were provided. Without functional and port/serial evidence, we can’t price confidently; we must request the specific tests that settle the main value risks.
